offers_products.reason: Sells Bike, Tread, Row connected fitness hardware and apparel, plus subscription software/content.

offers_services.reason: All-Access Membership streams classes and personalized plans; also delivery, assembly and repair services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Home fitness equipment and memberships sold directly to households and individual members.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Peloton also sells commercial equipment and content to gyms, hotels and corporate facilities, though a smaller part.

recurring_revenue.reason: Monthly All-Access Memberships from millions of members make up the larger share of revenue.

cyclical_demand.reason: Discretionary fitness equipment and memberships are easy for households to cancel or postpone in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Most revenue is monthly subscriptions; hardware is big-ticket but infrequent and is the smaller share.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from hardware and the streaming platform; instructors produce content but the product is technology-based.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are households buying bikes, treads and memberships.

asset_heavy.reason: Outsourced manufacturing and a streaming platform; studios and logistics are modest compared with heavy industry.

notes: Revenue mix between subscriptions and hardware is judged from general knowledge, not the website text.
